about: Maytronics Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, marketing, distribution, sale, and technical support of swimming pool cleaning equipment in Israel, Europe, North America, Oceania, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Private Pool Cleaning Robots, Public Pool Cleaning Robots, and Safety Products and Pool Accessories. The company offers private and public swimming pool cleaning robots under the Dolphin and Niya brand names; pool covers; robotic pool skimmers; pool parts and accessories, including pumps, filters, water heaters, chemical
